<DOCSTRING>
Logs the operation and its result.

@param {string} operation - The operation being logged.
@param {number} a - The first operand.
@param {number} b - The second operand.
@param {number} result - The result of the operation.
@returns {void} Logs the operation and its result to the console.
@example
log('+', 5, 3, 8);
// Output: [LOG] +(5, 3) = 8
</DOCSTRING>
